title: Cranes Near Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Tens of thousands of cranes roost at Linum**, about 40 km from the edge of Berlin, from **mid September into November**. The weekly counts this year start on **22 September**.
**Mid October is the safest bet.** Peak counts from 2018 to 2025 fell between **30 September and 31 October**, from 42,740 to 79,240 birds.
**The cranes fly in as the light goes**, from about **17:00** before the clocks change on **25 October** and about **16:00** after, until it is dark.
**No bus runs to Linum on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays this season**, including 3 October. On weekdays, take the **RE8 to Nauen and bus 758**.
**Before 25 October the last direct bus leaves at 18:24, before it is dark.** Stay for the **19:30** via Fehrbellin and Neuruppin, at Berlin Hbf at 21:49.
**At the weekend, take the train to Kremmen and ride 11 km**, mostly without a cycle path. Trains run back until **22:56**. A VBB bike ticket costs **€4.60** each way.
**Stay on roads and paths**, keep out of fields and the nature reserve, and **never touch a sick or dead bird**. Bird flu killed hundreds of cranes at Linum in October 2025.
